answer_1.quote: we focus in this paper on the problem of AMR-to-text generation, i.e. transducing AMR graphs into text that conveys the information in the AMR structure.
answer_1.outputs: generated English sentences from AMR graphs

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report BLEU scores, CHRF++ ... We also report METEOR scores.

answer_4.quote: We also perform human evaluation. Following Ribeiro et al., two evaluation criteria are used: (i) meaning similarity: how close in meaning the generated text is to the gold sentence; (ii) readability: how well the generated sentence reads. 30 human subjects rate the sentences on a 0-100 rating scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated sentence on meaning similarity and readability using a 0-100 scale.
